verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no format-support table or input→output conversion matrix. FFmpeg's own docs only note read/write or decode/encode direction for a few formats in scattered release notes: IAMF read and write, the VVC decoder now stable, MV-HEVC decoding, and Vulkan ProRes encode/decode with DPX decode only. That gives glancing per-format coverage information rather than a checkable pair reference. missing for 10: a documented, comprehensive list of supported input (demux/decode) and output (mux/encode) formats, an explicit way to look up a specific conversion pair, independent corroboration that such documentation is usable for this purpose.
